bounded_question: Can two ordinary full-length working-black curtain panels at clearly different depths form one irregular off-center vertical passage, while teal reads as a narrow deeper glimpse and plum as a softer more obstructed trace?

execution.prompt: Keep this original Reference-17 doorway crop, arch, warm edge catches, perspective and floor unchanged. Rework only the curtains and concealed light within the opening. Use two plain heavy working-black stage-curtain panels hanging naturally from above all the way to the floor in ordinary vertical pleats. Make them clearly occupy two different depths: one nearer panel overlaps farther into the opening while the second sits visibly farther back. Their uneven vertical edges must leave one narrow irregular off-center passage between them that reaches the floor; the route must read between full-length curtain edges, never beneath shortened, stepped, scalloped or cut-to-shape hems. Reveal only a thin deeper mineral-teal glimpse through the passage, with a much softer, more obstructed smoky-plum trace farther behind. Black fabric and dark depth dominate. No horizontal bands, swags, ribbons, tied-back presentation, colored jambs, paired lower color pools, beams, cones, bright sill, steps, fixtures, ornate/gothic architecture, people, mascot, text, logo or portal.
execution.reason_for_seed: Reuse Crop 02 seed to isolate the authorized construction change from stochastic seed variation.

acceptance: Both black curtain panels read as ordinary full-length hanging fabric reaching the floor; no shortened, stepped or scalloped hems.
Near/far depth difference between the two curtain panels is clearly legible.
One irregular off-center vertical passage reads between panel edges and reaches the floor.
Mineral-teal is a narrow deeper glimpse; smoky-plum is substantially softer and more obstructed, not a paired lower pool.
No horizontal bands, ornate/gothic arch drift, colored jambs, bright sill, steps, exposed fixtures, portal language, people, mascot, text or logo.

output_policy.raw_output: Untrusted crop-only proposal; never a pixel-locked edit by itself.
output_policy.later_composite: Only after a visually valid crop mechanism, fixed registration, and exact decoded-RGBA equality outside Boundary 01.
